extracted.intended_audience: aspiring and professional stand-up comedians; comedy students and performers
extracted.subtask_description: Practical to-do list and advice for writers and performers seeking to break into or improve in stand-up comedy, covering writing, performing, persona, business knowledge, and practice habits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find Your Originality.
rubrics_metrics.description: Get in touch with what is original about your sense of humor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Originality is a hallmark of exceptional art. In comedy, it’s what the entertainment industry looks for first and foremost when determining who has the makings for the big leagues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Master the Techniques of Stand-Up Comedy Writing.
rubrics_metrics.description: Capture the funny things you say and think by writing them down.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Once you get your spontaneous comic creations on paper, you can start to apply the writing techniques that will transform your ad-libs into stage-worthy stand-up comedy material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Master the Techniques of Stand-Up Comedy Performing.
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop the ability to produce onstage the emotions that give life to performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A stand-up, like an actor, must be capable of creating this emotional life night after night in a way that seems spontaneous and unrehearsed to the audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create Your Comic Persona.
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop a vivid and distinctive onstage personality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Your onstage personality should be as individual as your real-life personality, only more so—clear, vivid, and distinctive so audiences can quickly grasp who you are onstage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deepen Your Understanding of Comedy.
rubrics_metrics.description: Acquire knowledge and experience about comedy to increase versatility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gifted stand-ups’ versatility comes from the knowledge and experience they acquire about comedy during their formative years in stand-up.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study Great Comedians.
rubrics_metrics.description: Watch great comedians to learn what’s possible and improve your act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You’re not going to know what’s possible to accomplish in your stand-up unless you know the work of the great comedians who came before you.

rubrics_metrics.name: Perform! Perform! Perform!
rubrics_metrics.description: Practice performing stand-up as frequently as possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The only way you’ll absorb the techniques you learn is to use them onstage over and over again until they’ve become second nature to you.

rubrics_metrics.name: Never Blame Your Audience.
rubrics_metrics.description: Use audience reactions as a guide to improve writing and performing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Your audience can be an invaluable guide to improving your writing and performing. Over time, they’ll teach you what subjects and attitudes work best for you—and just as important, what doesn’t work for you.

rubrics_metrics.name: Know the Forms of Stand-Up Comedy.
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn the classical forms of stand-up to define and clarify your type of comedy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As in all art, standup has classical forms. Knowing them will help you define and clarify the type of stand-up you want to do; knowledge of the forms will expand and give shape to your comic ideas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand the Business.
rubrics_metrics.description: Be knowledgeable about the comedy business to make a living from stand-up.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To work as a stand-up, you need to be knowledgeable about the comedy business. There have never been more opportunities for comedians and comedy writers than there are now. The aim is not only to do stand-up, but also to be paid to do stand-up.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trust Your Nerves.
rubrics_metrics.description: Acknowledge and use stage nerves rather than fearing them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It’s OK to be nervous. Your nerves can give you invaluable assistance onstage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Have Fun.
rubrics_metrics.description: Make enjoyment a requirement of performing stand-up.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stand-up is the one endeavor where having fun is actually a requirement. When individuals become an audience, a transformation takes place: they stop feeling individually and start to feel collectively what the performer is feeling—so the performer’s enjoyment matters to the audience experience.
